identity.description: Harvest is a time tracking, invoicing, expense and project management app. Its API v2 docs are hosted at help.getharvest.com/api-v2.
identity.identity_notes: The official API v2 documentation at help.getharvest.com/api-v2 describes the Harvest product (clients, invoices, time entries, projects, etc.), matching the assignment hint harvestapp.com. The Developers area lives in Harvest ID; its exact URL was not verified.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization Code flow for server-side apps (recommended by vendor); Implicit Grant for client-side apps. Access tokens expire (expires_in in seconds).
auth.token_refresh: OAuth2 access tokens can be refreshed with a Refresh Token. Personal access token refresh behavior not established.
auth.scopes_notes: Scopes not established from sources reviewed.

access.production_restrictions: No app review or partner gate found for personal access tokens. OAuth2 app approval not established. The claim that API access is available on free accounts comes from a search summary; the support article returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched.

api.rate_limits: General API: 100 requests per 15 seconds. Reports API: 100 requests per 15 minutes.
api.limitations: Write operations verified only for time entries (create, update, delete, start/stop/restart). Other resource write ops not verified. Webhooks not confirmed.
